title: Assess product safety concerns and coordinate a recall
summary: When a physical product may present a safety defect or a regulator or supplier raises a concern. A specialist-reviewed safety decision with controlled affected-product tracing, communications and corrective action.
outcomes: A specialist-reviewed safety decision with controlled affected-product tracing, communications and corrective action.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a physical product may present a safety defect or a regulator or supplier raises a concern.

parts.title: Preserve the report and trace affected products
parts.guidance: Collect the reported incident, product identifiers, configuration, batch and distribution evidence. Preserve samples and records and route immediate danger to the responsible safety and emergency channels.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Appoint the safety lead and assess reporting duties
parts.guidance: Qualified product-safety and legal specialists assess the hazard, affected markets, required authority contacts and timing. Pause unsafe distribution or use through the authorized process while facts are reviewed.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Appoint the safety lead and assess reporting duties

parts.title: Prepare the affected-product and response plan
parts.guidance: Map customers, stock, suppliers and variants potentially affected. Draft the proposed containment, repair, replacement or recall actions and communications for specialist review without announcing unsupported conclusions.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize and coordinate the response
parts.guidance: The accountable decision makers approve required notifications and customer actions with the relevant authorities and advisers. Authorized teams execute traceable communications and logistics with clear safety instructions.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Verify effectiveness and corrective action
parts.guidance: Track contacted recipients, recovered or corrected units and unresolved exposure. Retain regulator correspondence, disposition evidence and root-cause actions and keep the response open until its defined closure criteria are met.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A specialist-reviewed safety decision with controlled affected-product tracing, communications and corrective action.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
